description: This file defines the 'Zone' model class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, specifically in the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Localisation'. It includes methods to retrieve zone data by ID and by country ID, with caching mechanisms integrated. The class extends a base system engine model and is part of the localisation feature set.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Model representing a geographical zone within the localisation namespace, providing methods to access zone details by ID or associated country ID.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific zone based on its zone ID, returning an array with zone data.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves all zones associated with a given country ID, utilizing caching for performance.
